heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–35, title XII, § 1205(c), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 716

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–601, § 6, Dec. 30, 1970, 84 Stat. 1672, provided for appointment of a technical advisory committee to assist the Secretary in carrying out the purposes of the Poison Prevention Packaging Act of 1970.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Aug. 13, 1981, see section 1215 of Pub. L. 97–35, set out as an Effective Date of 1981 Amendment note under section 2052 of this title.
